comment: Phase 3 api-key credential-mediation route (reconstructed). #165 referenced an undefined 'RsFilterChain' heap object so it never built. This is a valid route mirroring 02-mcp-invest: rsFilter validates the inbound token (introspection), McpValidationFilter validates the MCP protocol AND buffers the request body so the terminal apikey-dispatch handler can re-read it (this buffering is what prevents the Vert.x event-loop deadlock on request.entity.string). The handler pulls the vault service key via the BFF bridge and calls demo_data_service with X-API-Key.
name: mcp-apikey-dispatcher
